steps.prompt: A passed pawn has no enemy pawns in front of it on its own file or the files next to it. Nothing can stop it except pieces, so it is a big strength.
steps.explanation: A passed pawn has no enemy pawns in front of it on its own file or the files next to it. Nothing can stop it except pieces, so it is a big strength.
d5 is passed: no black pawns on the c, d or e files.
steps.hint: Which white pawn has a free road?

steps.prompt: What do we call the white pawn on d4?
steps.explanation: No white pawns on the c- or e-files can protect it: an isolated pawn is a target.

steps.prompt: Click one of White's doubled pawns.
steps.explanation: Two pawns on the same file are doubled. They cannot protect each other.

steps.prompt: What should you usually do with a passed pawn?
correct: Push it, with your pieces supporting it
